t: Beezeh open muttar liqqach beyom tob min hachenvani mine maakal
s: Beezeh open muttar liqqach beyom tob min hachenvani mine maakal ubo t' seipim: muttar liqqach min hachenvani mine maakal umashqeh beyom tob, ubilbad shello yazkir lo sekum minyan, velo shem midda, velo shem damim, kede shello yehe nireh kemiqqach umimkar ella kishela, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"g leinyan shabbat, vehu haddin leyom tob.

Veim hachenvani hu nokri — asur liqqach mimmennu dabar sheyyesh beoto hammin bimchubbar o mechussar tzida, kegon perot retubbim o dagim, ella im ken nikkar bahem shello nilqetu veshello nitztzodu hayyom, kemo shennitbaer besimman tqt"v, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh. Veken asur liqqach mimmennu betzim, shemma noledu hayyom. Abal dabar sheen bemino bimchubbar velo mechussar tzida, kegon perot yebeshim veavvazim vetarnegolim — muttar liqqach mimmennu (al derek shennitbaer besimman shk"g) apillu hubeu hayyom michutz lattechum im hi ir sherubbah nokrim, kemo shennitbaer besimman tqt"v ayyen sham.

Veken muttar liqqach mimmennu qemach apillu nitchan hayyom im rob loqeche qemach shebbair hen nokrim, shebbevadday letzorek nokri techanuhu. Veap al pi sheqqemach zeh nolad beyom tob, ap al pi ken hu muttar ap lehaoserim nolad beyom tob, dekevan sheggam hattebua qodem shettechanah hi reuya laakila laasot mimmenna qelayot o daysa, nimtza sheqqemach hazzeh eno ella keokel shenniprad meokel acher, veen bo din nolad, kevan sheap keshehaya qemach zeh kanus betok hachitta haya alayv torat okel.

Veken muttar liqqach mimmennu pat shenneepa beyom tob (bemaqom shennohagin hetter bepat shel palter nokri sheapao kede lemokro, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman qy"b) im rob loqeche pat shebbair hen nokrim, shebbevadday bishbilam nitchan haqqemach. Veim yadua shehaqqemach nitchan meereb yom tob, kegon shehebiu qemach lehappalter meereb yom tob vachatamo yisrael bechotamo meereb yom tob kede shello yachalipennu hannokri beqemach shennitchan beyom tob ulemachar ba hayyisrael veraa shello nitqalqel chotamo — muttar liqqach miqqemach zeh apillu im rob loqeche qemach shebbair hen yisrael. Veken muttar liqqach happat sheapa hannokri miqqemach zeh apillu im rob loqeche pat shebbair hen yisrael.

Pat shel palter nokri shenneepa beshabbat — asur liqqach oto beyom tob shelleacharayv mishshum issur hakana im rob loqeche pat shebbair hen yisrael, apillu nitchan haqqemach meereb shabbat, shehare pat zeh eno rauy leyisrael bo bayyom shenneepa, kevan sherob halloqechin hen yisrael bevadday bishbilam apa, nimtza sheal yede apiyya shebbeshabbat hukan happat leoklo beyom tob, veen shabbat mekina leyom tob. Abal im rob loqeche pat shebbair hen nokrim, ap al pi shebbeshabbat atzmah yesh lehachamir shello liqqach pat shenneepa bo bayyom ap al pi sheapao letzorek nokri, mittaam shennitbaer besimman shk"h, mikkol maqom beyom tob shelleacharayv yesh lehattiro, kevan sheyyesh mattirin oto apillu beshabbat atzmo, vedibrehem iqqar, kemo shennitbaer sham.

Kol hetter leqichot ellu shebbearnu besimman zeh ubesimman tqt"v ubesimman tqy"g, hen perot, hen dagim, hen qemach, hen pat, veken shear kol leqichot shebbaolam — en hetter ella kesheshshumat hammiqqach yadua veen tzarik liqtzotz damim im hannokri. Veap al pi sheshshumato yadua — asur leshallem lo hammaot beyom tob atzmo. Apillu im mareh lipne hannokri et hammaot kede sheyyittol beatzmo — asur, vaapillu al yede nokri acher asur leshallem lo, dekol shehammaot maggiin leyad hammoker beyom tob — nikkar haddabar shehu miqqach umimkar, sheissuro meporash bakkatub binchemya, velo hittiru ella kesheeno noten lo maot, daazay en nireh kemiqqach umimkar ella kishela, veal derek shennitbaer besimman shk"g ayyen sham.

Vaapillu beereb yom tob asur lomar lenokri sheyyiqneh lo lemachar mine maakal, apillu hu tzarik lahem lesimchat yom tob. Vaapillu omer lehannokri sheyyiqneh lo bead maot shello veachar yom tob yachazir lo meotayv — hare zeh asur, shehare hannokri hu shelucho liqnot beyom tob. Vaapillu bediabad shekkebar qana lo hannokri bishlichuto — asur lehanot mehem beyom tob im hayyisrael hu ragil laasot ken, deim nattir otam baakila beyom tob — yesh lachush sheyyachazor laasot ken, kevan shehu chashud al kak. Abal im eno ragil laasot ken — en leqonso al zeh, umuttar lo leekol otam beyom tob atzmo im yadua shehubeu mittok hattechum o shehi ir sherubbah nokrim.

Lomar lechenvani: malle li keli zeh yayin — dino beyom tob kemo beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"g ayyen sham. Veken lehatil goralot — dino beyom tob kemo beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"b ayyen sham.
Lo yamod adam seorim veyitten lipne behemto, sheasur limdod beyom tob, ella meshaer beomed dato venoten lah.
